```{webr}
#| include: false
# ---- Grading helpers (hidden from students) ----
.ok <- function(msg = "Correct! Well done.") list(correct = TRUE, type = "success", message = msg)
.no <- function(msg = "Not quite. Have a look at the hint and try again.") list(correct = FALSE, type = "error", message = msg)

# Compare the value the student's code returned with the value the solution returned
.check_result <- function(result, solution, ok = "Correct! Well done.",
                          no = "Not quite. Compare your output with what the task asks for.") {
  if (isTRUE(all.equal(result, solution, check.attributes = TRUE))) .ok(ok) else .no(no)
}

# Check that variables created by the student match those of the solution
.check_vars <- function(vars, env, sol_env, ok = "Correct! Well done.") {
  for (v in vars) {
    if (!exists(v, envir = env, inherits = FALSE))
      return(.no(paste0("I can't find a variable called `", v, "`. Did you create it (spelling matters!)?")))
    if (!isTRUE(all.equal(get(v, envir = env), get(v, envir = sol_env))))
      return(.no(paste0("`", v, "` exists, but its value isn't what I expected. Check it and try again.")))
  }
  .ok(ok)
}

# Check that the student's code contains certain pieces of text (e.g. function names)
.check_code <- function(code, patterns, ok = "Correct! Well done.") {
  code <- paste(code, collapse = "\n")
  for (p in patterns) {
    if (!grepl(p, code, fixed = TRUE))
      return(.no(paste0("Your code should use `", p, "`. Have another look at the task.")))
  }
  .ok(ok)
}

# Check a ggplot: must be a plot, use the given geoms and the given aesthetics
.check_plot <- function(p, geoms = character(), aes = character(), ok = "Great plot!") {
  if (!inherits(p, "ggplot"))
    return(.no("Your code should return a ggplot. Did you start with `ggplot(...)` and connect layers with `+`?"))
  used_geoms <- vapply(p$layers, function(l) class(l$geom)[1], character(1))
  for (g in geoms) {
    if (!g %in% used_geoms)
      return(.no(paste0("Your plot needs a `", tolower(sub("^Geom", "geom_", g)), "()` layer.")))
  }
  mapped <- c(names(p$mapping), unlist(lapply(p$layers, function(l) names(l$mapping))),
              unlist(lapply(p$layers, function(l) names(l$aes_params))))
  for (a in aes) {
    if (!a %in% mapped)
      return(.no(paste0("Your plot should set the `", a, "` aesthetic.")))
  }
  .ok(ok)
}
```
